verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is that llamafile supports GGUF models (Llama, Mistral, Gemma, Phi). That points to one model format family, but the docs never mention quantization levels or support for FP8, INT4, GPTQ or AWQ. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of supported quantization types (e.g., INT4), evidence of loading GPTQ, AWQ or FP8 checkpoints, and hands-on corroboration of quantized-model loading.
